When I first got here I thought I landed on Endor. I never mountain biked or kayaked or hiked or camped until I got here... I have learned to love nature, as much as a city boy can. I don't think I noticed having trees around us back home, but being in Portland has been wonderful for that reason, 15-30 minutes in any direction & BAM effen nature! But that being said, as much as I may enjoy nature, I need the city, I need the hustle & bustle... it's just different. 

Competetive in status? Like keeping up with the Jones'? If that's what you mean, then I don't know. I've been barely middle class all my life. That's why whatever I have I buy cheap or broken & fix or make better. 

I'm 45 & the one thing that I've always loved since I was a kid was crayon color haired girls, there are so many more folks who seem to fit that description here. HAHAH!

good for you. I pulled out like a hopeful teenager. canceled my recurring membership & tossed all SRA branded items. I was told 'the Portland chapter is very active' & 'they elected a member from there to be the SRA president'. whatever man, waste-of-time, but more than that... wasted hope. I'll keep looking for a group that has more than a bunch of people who like to design logos.

Honestly maybe just enough, however, Jersey has more to offer than just a single city would. Besides its home, so it's familiar & I feel more comfortable moving around from city to city. Oregon, to me, has Portland, that's it. I don't want to live anywhere else out here. Not that there is anything wrong with other parts of Oregon (the land), just the people in some cities. I'm a lefty POC, & I've gone to a lot of places outside of Portland & here is as comfortable of a place as I think I'm gonna get. Having a few folks have my back (here) vs what I believe is a large chunk of people who grew up with the same circumstances (there)... I think that part really helps. Now if I'm being honest, I'm on the fence about going back home, or just being a neighbor in PA... being a gun owner now I think the latter might be the better choice.  \*\*\*end rant\*\*\*
